translation.title: Sodium Fusidate Adhesive Patch
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for staphylococcal pyoderma (impetigo, folliculitis, boils) and for secondary infection of burns, wounds, sutured wounds, and skin-graft wounds.
translation.usage: Clean the affected area, peel off the backing paper, and apply 1 patch directly to the affected area once a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it or if you have an infection caused by non-susceptible bacteria (in particular Pseudomonas aeruginosa). Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding. To prevent the emergence of resistant bacteria, confirm susceptibility and use it only for the minimum period needed for treatment. When applying it to the face, take care that it does not come into contact with the eyes. Rash, mild pain and irritation, or signs of sensitisation (itching, redness, swelling, papules, blisters) may occur occasionally. If any of these occur, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store in a cool place and keep out of reach of children.
